reasoning_content:
The stack is up, migrations applied, Apache running. Now verify reachability. APP_DOMAIN=localhost, traefik on port 80. TLS cert resolver is letsencrypt which will fail for localhost, but HTTP should work. Let's test.

TRAEFIK_HTTP_ROUTER_MIDDLEWARES default yii-https-redirect would redirect HTTP to HTTPS. We set APP_DOMAIN=localhost; cert resolver letsencrypt will fail. Let me test HTTP endpoint. Better to set TRAEFIK_HTTP_ROUTER_MIDDLEWARES=yii-noop and TRAEFIK_TLS_CERTRESOLVER= empty for local. But first test what we have.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -sS -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP direct -> %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\\n\" http://localhost/ ; curl -sS -k -o /dev/null -w \"HTTPS -> %{http_code}\\n\" https://localhost/ 2>&1; echo \"---via Host header---\"; curl -sS -H \"Host: localhost\" -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" http://127.0.0.1/", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test HTTP reachability"}
